add-column: The two session columns are nullable and default-free catalog additions under a 1s lock_timeout, without a heap rewrite.
add-foreign-key: The session foreign key is added NOT VALID, avoiding an existing-row scan while the 1s lock_timeout bounds locks on session and oauth_consent.
create-policy: Both policies are installed on the new empty handoff table under a 1s lock_timeout; their expressions inspect table ownership or return false, without reading application relations.
create-table-references: Foreign keys are installed with a new empty table, so no existing rows are scanned; the 1s lock_timeout bounds referenced-table lock acquisition.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE RLS apply only to the new empty handoff table before it becomes visible to application traffic, under a 1s lock_timeout.
